answer: Each new agent must first fill a vault of 64 GB of dedicated RAM, then prove it by walking a vine of sequential cache-line reads: the verifier draws pseudo-random byte offsets from a cryptographic seed, forcing the agent to follow each line in order and seal every hop with a chained signature, so the traversal resembles a bee tracing one unbroken nectar trail across scattered flowers—skip a bloom and the whole route dies. A stalled or out-of-order round is rejected on the spot, its stake slashed, its identity discarded.
